response.sql: WITH filtered_standings AS (SELECT r.name, ds.points FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId WHERE ds.points >= 1.0), race_averages AS (SELECT name, AVG(points) as avg_points FROM filtered_standings GROUP BY name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points) as overall_average FROM race_averages) SELECT ra.name, ra.avg_points, ra.avg_points - oa.overall_average as difference FROM race_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE oa.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND ra.avg_points > oa.overall_average ORDER BY ra.name;
